owner_decisions: Tied or absent Eldritch dominance uses the corresponding ordinary currency behavior.
Prefix or suffix Eldritch intent is a separate explicit setup-and-craft solver option.
Optimality status must be reported honestly as exact, bounded, or heuristic.
Solve time and memory have no owner-set completion ceiling; strive for the fastest practical solver beyond the minimum directional targets.
The 50 ms worker-step and 250 ms cancellation acknowledgement budgets are approved.
Per-case limits are approved as operational guardrails.
Every compiled-strategy verification uses 10000 simulator runs.
Verified executable fragment diagnostics are explicit native shadow requests and do not change ordinary solver authority.
Negligible-value policy trimming for readable strategies is a later owner-controlled follow-up.
